verdict.rationale: Pendo installs via a single JavaScript snippet (pendo-docs-16) and states that no manual event tagging is required (pendo-docs-23). It captures historical behavior retroactively from day one (pendo-docs-24), and AI tagging identifies pages and features (pendo-docs-25), which covers clicks and pageviews without per-event code. Session replay records click-by-click behavior and masks inputs, which implies input capture (pendo-docs-2, pendo-docs-5). Missing for 10: explicit documentation of automatic form-interaction capture in analytics, in-depth technical docs on autocapture scope beyond marketing pages, independent or hands-on corroboration.
